notes: Sourced directly from Eventide's official "H9 Harmonizer User Guide" (downloads.eventideaudio.com/manuals/h9/H9-UserGuide.pdf, (c)2022 Eventide Inc., part #159035 Rev F), fetched over verified HTTPS. This single manual covers the whole H9 hardware family (H9 Core, H9, H9 Max) — the H9 Max is the same physical stompbox as the standard H9, differing only in which algorithm bundle is licensed/unlocked in software; all physical connectors and specs are identical across the family and are confirmed for H9 Max explicitly in the manual's "Key Features" (99 Presets for H9 and H9MAX). Desktop stompbox/pedal form factor — not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted. Dimensions: 5.25"(H) x 4.65"(W) x 1.96"(D), weight 1.53 lbs. USB port is physically a Mini-B receptacle per the manual; "usb-b" was chosen as the closest id in the allowed connector list since "mini-usb" is not an available option. No manufacturer product/spec web page could be reached (eventideaudio.com product URLs 404'd during this session and B&H returned 403), so the manufacturer's own PDF user guide was used as the authoritative source instead of a retailer spec table.

ports.name: Input 1
ports.note: Mono 1/4" phone jack; instrument level, accepts line-level up to +4dBU

ports.name: EXP (Expression Pedal / Aux Switch)
ports.note: Stereo 1/4" jack; accepts expression pedal or dual/single auxiliary footswitch

ports.name: USB
ports.note: Manual specifies Mini-B receptacle, USB 2.0 cables only; usb-b chosen as closest listed connector to Mini-B

ports.name: MIDI Out/Thru
ports.note: 5-pin DIN, female; switchable function (Out, Thru, Thru+C, or Merge) via System Mode menu

ports.name: Power Input (DC Adaptor Jack)
ports.note: 2.5mm x 5mm barrel, center pin positive. Spec sheet lists supplied adapter as 9VDC 500mA; rear-panel silkscreen shown in the manual's connection diagram reads 9-12VDC / 4.3W acceptable input range
